mixture_weights: eight equal fixed empirical weights, not reweighted by model evidence or likelihood; select first8 indices of permutation of1024 from state_seed, first16 for sensitivity
posterior_target: conditional beta-power hyperposterior for each fixed global effective-n vector; CUT mixture of normalized conditional posteriors
formula_score: u_id = sum(child in PSU i and domain d) w_j*(y_j-p_d)/sum(domain observed weights)
formula_contribution: c_id = m_h/(m_h-1)*(u_id-mean_i_in_full_stratum(u_id))^2 for m_h>=2; c_id=u_id^2 for m_h=1
formula_taylor: V_d=sum_all_full_frame_PSUs(c_id); empty-domain PSUs carry zero scores but centered contributions need not be zero
replicate_formula: C_bhi~Multinomial(m_h;1/m_h); V_bhd=m_h^2/(m_h-1)^2*[sum_i C_bhi*u_hid^2-(sum_i C_bhi*u_hid)^2/m_h] for m_h>=2. Sum full strata plus fixed singleton components. Exact conditional expectation equals observed Taylor variance.
replicated_target_limitation: first-order conditional linearized-PSU empirical bootstrap variance; observed linearized PSU scores held fixed but recentred inside each resample. Not Rao-Wu weights, not full nonlinear ratio bootstrap or a nested bootstrap; conditional response and lower-stage uncertainty omitted
singleton_default: C_bhi=1 for m_h=1; observed lonely-adjust Taylor component fixed; uncertainty unidentified and not propagated
singleton_sensitivity: optional explicit assumption scenarios fixed-certainty removal or independent 0/2 pseudo multiplier; never claim design identification
response: fixed observed outcome availability and original outcome-specific weights; no refit of response model and no correction of MNAR
gvf_eligibility: training domains with direct0<p<1, positive finite Taylor contribution above1e-15, at least two observed PSUs; require at least five stable domains
gvf_weights: max(nPSU_d-nRepresentedStrata_d,1), ridge1 on slopes, intercept unpenalized; predictor centering/scaling from eligible training domains only
pstar: observed p for interior0<p<1; Jeffreys surrogate(nKish*p+0.5)/(nKish+1) only for zero/one variance-scale stabilization
variance_stabilization: Vstar_d=a_d*V_d+(1-a_d)*V_GVF_d, a_d=dfProxy/(dfProxy+4), dfProxy=max(nPSU-nRepresentedStrata,0); set a_d=0 at direct zero/one
boundaries: original direct0/1 retained in all power-likelihood exponents, no added success/failure, no domain discarded because of direct boundary
priors_and_spatial_basis: unchanged frozen statistical priors and spectral basis; q40 ENDES, q12 simulations
state_seed_offsets: shared underlying stratum replication and state indices for both independently fitted outcomes; endpoint MCMC seeds distinct; states retain global cross-domain dependence
mcmc_seed_formula: 20261007 + year*100 + (10000 if territorial_training else0) + (state_index_zero_based*100003); inherited endpoint+1009 and retry+104729 offsets, all uint32 valid
performance_selection: no tuning on reserved-year or territorial held-out responses; no discard of failed states to improve performance; failure reported and predeclared retry only
outer_integration_sensitivity: CUT16 first16 of same prespecified permutation, only2019full optional extension; first8 shared with primaryCUT8, no best-state selection; explicit root dispatch flag required
reproduction_scope: phase2 sources and outputs only; original sources, frozen16 kernels, archived documents and ZIP untouched
